title: Billing Operations Standard: Amount of the Small Business Electricity Supply Multi-Site Credit
content:
**Standard.** The standard multi-site credit for a cycle of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement is the plan's multi-site credit per cycle, rounded half up to the cent. The plan's multi-site credit per cycle is the figure the agreement's own plan sets for the multi-site credit; a plan whose figure is zero yields no multi-site credit.

## Order of working

The amount is put together in this order: first the dollar amounts that make up the cycle's credit, beginning with the plan's multi-site credit per cycle, are added into one multi-site subtotal; any multiplication of that subtotal comes next; any proportion applied to the amount acts on the result of that step; rounding half up to the cent happens only once, on the final amount.

| Stage | What it holds |
|---|---|
| Multi-site subtotal | the dollar amounts of the cycle's credit added together, beginning with the plan's multi-site credit per cycle |
| Multiplication | the multi-site subtotal multiplied, where a multiplier is set |
| Proportion | the result of the multiplication stage, taken in proportion where a proportion is set |
| Final amount | the result, rounded half up to the cent; no earlier figure is rounded |

## Reading the standard

| Agreement's plan figure for the multi-site credit per cycle | Credit for the cycle |
|---|---|
| above zero | worked from that figure in the order above, one credit per cycle |
| zero | none |

## Hypothetical worked example

An agreement whose plan figure is a hypothetical 6.00 USD per cycle: the multi-site subtotal is 6.00 USD and the final amount, rounded half up to the cent once, is 6.00 USD, entered as a positive credit amount and shown on the bill as a reduction.
